subject.title: [Bug]: codex agent fails ("exited with code 1") — macOS XProtect deletes bundled @openai/codex@0.128.0 as malware; codex-acp@0.0.44 pins the flagged version

question: Should this fix remain a tested built-in adapter update with a documented explicit `CODEX_PATH` override, or also automatically choose a system Codex executable when the override is unset?
rationale: The adapter update directly fixes the reproduced regression, while automatic fallback adds Codex-specific launch semantics and a long-term executable-precedence convention.

options.title: Upgrade And Document
options.body: Bump the built-in adapter, validate its ACP surface, and document `CODEX_PATH` while preserving explicit user control.

options.title: Add Automatic Fallback
options.body: Also inject a PATH-resolved system Codex when `CODEX_PATH` is unset, accepting broader agent-specific launch behavior.

recommendation.title: Upgrade And Document
recommendation.body: Bump the built-in adapter, validate its ACP surface, and document `CODEX_PATH` while preserving explicit user control.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent built-in adapter-range and release history makes this the strongest available owner for the fallback-policy decision.
